outcome: Rate of vaginal and cesarean deliveries
cohort: Women who gave birth in the municipality of Patos de Minas, Brazil, between 2011 and 2015
finding: Cesarean section rates were higher than recommended, and while a higher number of prenatal consultations was associated with cesarean delivery, there was no significant relationship between type of delivery and maternal death.
mod_finding: The study found an association between cesarean delivery and a higher number of prenatal consultations.
gest_age: Gestational age at birth was measured as an outcome
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured as an outcome
